ranked.headline: Generative design models add physical guidance and preference optimization
ranked.summary: Pretrained generators for proteins and small molecules are now being steered by explicit energy, structural, reward, or feedback signals.

ranked.headline: Single-cell methods infer cell states, communication, and regulatory programs
ranked.summary: Recent single-cell frameworks model aging, cell-cell communication, isoform structure, and library-size bias, expanding inference beyond expression profiles.

ranked.headline: Reducing annotation and input redundancy in pathology and spatial omics segmentation
ranked.summary: EvoPS, Athena and histology-informed tiling show that curated patch selection and slide diversity can replace dense input volume in pathology models.

ranked.headline: Fusing protein sequence, structure and chemical embeddings into shared latent spaces
ranked.summary: Retrieval conditioning and multimodal alignment are extending protein language models beyond sequence-only inputs for prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking structure-based docking and MD workflows across biomolecular targets
ranked.summary: Physics-based and ML docking are now compared head-to-head on PROTAC ternary complexes, alongside ensemble-based scoring frameworks.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks probe gene network inference, single-cell pipelines and LLM annotation
ranked.summary: Benchmarking tools now span GRN inference, simulation, scRNA-seq preprocessing, and LLM agent annotation of spatial transcriptomics data.

ranked.headline: Cell-type-resolved chromatin contacts and enhancer programs across tissues and disease
ranked.summary: Single-nucleus and long-range contact datasets now link cell-type regulatory maps to disease and public reference resources.

ranked.headline: Inferring cellular dynamics and regulation from single-cell snapshots and paired omics
ranked.summary: Single-cell snapshot and paired RNA-protein data now support explicit models of trajectories, regulatory flow, and transcription-translation noise.

ranked.headline: Computational checks reveal artifacts and new regulatory events in RNA datasets
ranked.summary: Large RNA-chromatin, RNA-seq, and single-cell morphological datasets now demand explicit validation of computational inferences.

ranked.headline: Omics software tools add validation and traceability to individual analysis steps
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published resource target standardization, validation, and reuse at discrete steps of quantitative omics and systems biology pipelines.

ranked.headline: Pretrained embeddings combined with graph learning for RNA and gene prediction
ranked.summary: Pretrained language and sentence embeddings are being layered with graph structure and disease association to predict RNA and gene interactions.

ranked.headline: Models separate biological expression from technical and annotation confounds in RNA-seq
ranked.summary: Eight recent single-cell and spatial RNA-seq methods target specific error sources in cell typing, splicing, rare populations, and allele quantification.

ranked.headline: Deep and signature-based models score variant and RNA modification effects in genomics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair pretrained sequence models and curated benchmarks with interpretable outputs for variant and modification analysis.

ranked.headline: Proteome-wide prediction of interactions, disorder grammars and functional segments
ranked.summary: Protein language model embeddings and structure-based scoring are now applied across whole proteomes rather than to individual proteins.

ranked.headline: Structure, transcriptomics, and pharmacokinetics fused to predict toxicity outcomes
ranked.summary: Large public Tox21 and DILImap resources now allow structural, transcriptomic, and pharmacokinetic data to be combined in interpretable toxicity prediction…

ranked.headline: Dynamical models infer regulatory and evolutionary dynamics from single-cell data
ranked.summary: Single-cell snapshots and lineage trees are now fit with explicit dynamical models to infer regulatory networks and expression evolution.

ranked.headline: Generative models now design codon and RNA sequences for translation
ranked.summary: Recent RNA foundation models and ribosome-profiling-trained generative designers extend sequence modeling from prediction toward translational design.

ranked.headline: Marker gene selection front-ends phylogenetic and assembly-level genome recovery
ranked.summary: Marker-based selection ahead of inference now spans microbial phylogenetics and metagenomic coassembly in recent publications.

ranked.headline: Learned models adapted to cryoEM, cryo-ET, and microscopy segmentation tasks
ranked.summary: Foundation and self-supervised models are being adapted to specific imaging modalities, while training-free tools also emerge for segmentation.

ranked.headline: Software workflows target proteomic, metabolite, and multiplexed imaging data analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints introduce or benchmark software for DIA proteomics, raw-file metadata, metabolite annotation, and multiplexed imaging analysis.

ranked.headline: Modeling spatial neighborhood context for perturbation and intercellular inference
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple spatial neighborhood structure with perturbation, metabolic, and network inference on high-resolution spatial platforms.

ranked.headline: Language models are being fused with genomic, protein, and omics data encoders
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study pair genomic, metabolite, and single-cell encoders with LLM interfaces for interactive querying of molecular data.

ranked.headline: Knowledge graphs structure biomedical retrieval and drug repositioning predictors
ranked.summary: Graph-structured biomedical knowledge is now paired with deep-learning prediction and retrieval-augmented generation over large literature corpora.

ranked.headline: MD simulations reveal allosteric and conformational switches in viral and host proteins
ranked.summary: Coarse-grained and atomistic MD now map loop ensembles, variant-specific spike allostery, and phosphatidylserine scrambling routes.

ranked.headline: Compressed indexes and alignment-free methods scale microbial genome analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications introduce compressed indexes and alignment-free methods for scalable microbial genomics.

ranked.headline: Computational models link pathogen genome evolution to resistance and transmission
ranked.summary: Genetic algorithms, mixture-of-experts and hidden Markov models are now applied to SARS-CoV-2 and antimicrobial resistance genomic evolution.

ranked.headline: Genome mining uncovers bacteriocins, extremocins, and phytoplasma effectors at scale
ranked.summary: Population-scale genomes and metagenomes now enable systematic discovery of bacterial antimicrobial and effector loci beyond homology-based annotation.

ranked.headline: Expression and annotation data shape comparative plant and eukaryotic genome analyses
ranked.summary: Deep learning, contrastive expression models, and annotation audits now address plant regulation and genome evolution questions in parallel.

ranked.headline: Methylation linkage corrects long-read phasing switch errors and bridges phased blocks
ranked.summary: Long-read methods now draw on base modifications, new file formats, and benchmarked pipelines as haplotype and variant-calling evidence.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models predict binding sites, pockets, and peptide-MHC presentation
ranked.summary: Recent work links learned binding-site, pocket, and epitope predictors directly to docking, structure-guided design, and neoantigen generation.

ranked.headline: Modeling and proteomics resolve metabolic pathways in bacteria, yeast and human cells
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs flux modeling, dynamic proteomics, and 18O labeling to resolve metabolic routes from plasmid production to inositol pyrophosphates.

ranked.headline: Learned models of biomolecular dynamics are constrained by physics and kinetics
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs physics-informed learning and kinetic models to resolve metastable states and dynamics from simulation data.

ranked.headline: Measured tissue structure and strain constrain constitutive parameters in FE models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple measured tissue structure or strain to finite element and Bayesian models of cardiac, skin, and cartilage mechanics.

ranked.headline: Nonlinear EEG measures and biophysical models track brain states
ranked.summary: Mechanistic and adaptive modelling of EEG and iEEG now links measured brain-state dynamics to model parameters and stimulation.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking computational predictors against large-scale folding and aggregation data
ranked.summary: Mega-scale folding, aggregation and antibody sequencing datasets now enable direct tests of predictors and methods against experimental reference data.

ranked.headline: Persistent homology and Grassmann manifolds resolve multiscale structure in omics data
ranked.summary: Scale-aware topological and manifold methods are now being applied to spatial and single-cell transcriptomic data.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-scale nutcracker genome and reference-free diversity and SNP array tools
ranked.summary: Chromosome-scale references and new marker tools now enable diversity estimates and introgression tracking in Clark's Nutcracker and spruce taxa.

ranked.headline: Condensate aging, simulation tools, and cytoplasmic viscosity probe material state
ranked.summary: Open simulation pipelines and viscoelastic models now link condensate sticker-spacer design and aging to measurable material properties.

ranked.headline: Emergent boundaries set survival-linked stability in ecosystems, cell models and flocks
ranked.summary: Models of ecosystems, cell biology and multi-agent inference now treat emergent boundaries as the object of analysis.

ranked.headline: Re-representing brain imaging to expose subject-specific and time-varying structure
ranked.summary: Individual-level brain dynamics and topology-preserving encodings are becoming learnable from longitudinal and dynamic imaging data.
